sections.text: Approved vendors may receive Dataset Y provided they hold a current Data Processing Agreement (DPA).
Any transfer of Dataset Y to external vendors must receive prior written approval from the Data Owner.
Vendor X is prohibited from receiving Dataset Y under any circumstances, regardless of DPA status.
Approved Vendor means any vendor on the current Approved Vendor Registry, excluding vendors subject to specific restrictions.
Exception requests for Dataset Y sharing may be submitted to the Data Governance Committee for review within 30 days of denial.
